value.code:
SELECT r.value AS region, count(*) AS accounts
FROM card_values r
WHERE r.entity_type = 'Account' AND r.field = 'region'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card_values d, json_each(d.value) j WHERE d.card_id = r.card_id AND d.field = 'domain' AND j.value = :domain)
GROUP BY r.value
ORDER BY accounts DESC, region

value.code:
WITH nodes AS (
  SELECT n.card_id, n.card AS node FROM card_values n
  WHERE n.entity_type = 'Node' AND n.field = 'name'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card_values d, json_each(d.value) j WHERE d.card_id = n.card_id AND d.field = 'domain' AND j.value = :domain)
), counted AS (
  SELECT nodes.node, (
    SELECT count(*) FROM card_values s, json_each(s.value) j
    WHERE s.entity_type = 'TestSolution' AND s.field = 'nodes'
      AND j.value = nodes.node
  ) AS solutions FROM nodes
)
SELECT node, solutions,
  CASE solutions WHEN 0 THEN 'gap' WHEN 1 THEN 'warning' END AS level
FROM counted
ORDER BY solutions, node
